def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    n = len(state)
    result = []
    for r in range(n):
        row = []
        for c in range(n):
            # Compute knight-octad neighbors in toroidal grid
            neighbors = [
                state[(r+1)%n][(c+2)%n],
                state[(r+1)%n][(c-2)%n],
                state[(r-1)%n][(c+2)%n],
                state[(r-1)%n][(c-2)%n],
                state[(r+2)%n][(c+1)%n],
                state[(r+2)%n][(c-1)%n],
                state[(r-2)%n][(c+1)%n],
                state[(r-2)%n][(c-1)%n],
            ]
            # Sum of neighbor values mod 4
            total = sum(neighbors) % 4
            row.append(total)
        result.append(row)
    return result
